Join the community Get the most out of Salesforce with partners, apps, and agents. Discover AgentExchange Try for free What is Salesforce? Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM (customer relationship management) platform. We bring companies and customers together by providing a unified set of applications — powered by agentic AI and data — that help every department, including sales, service, marketing, commerce, and IT, work as one. You can learn more about what Salesforce is and what Salesforce does by visiting our official resources . Our cloud-based agentic solutions help you find more leads, close more deals, and provide better service to your customers, all on a single, integrated agentic platform. What is CRM software and why do businesses in India need it? CRM stands for customer relationship management. It’s a technology for managing all your company’s relationships and interactions with customers and potential customers. A CRM system helps you: • Organise contact information, leads, and customer service data • Automate tasks like logging calls and sending follow-up emails • Analyse data to understand customer behaviour and business performance A CRM, especially one powered by AI like Salesforce, is essential for growth because it gives you a single , 360-degree view of every customer , allowing you to build stronger, more profitable relationships at scale. What is agentic AI and how is it used in Salesforce? Agentic AI refers to advanced artificial intelligence systems that can act autonomously to achieve a specific goal with minimal human intervention. Unlike traditional AI that only generates content or analyses data, agentic AI can reason, plan multistep actions, and execute tasks. In Salesforce, agentic AI — part of our Agentforce technology — is used to: • Automate complex workflows like lead qualification or service case resolution • Predict business outcomes, such as which deals are likely to close • Personalise every customer interaction across marketing, sales, and service channels How does Salesforce CRM help businesses grow in India? Salesforce offers agentic CRM solutions tailored for companies of all sizes, from startups and small businesses to large global enterprises. Our Agentforce 360 Platform is flexible and scalable, allowing you to start with the essentials you need — like sales, service, commerce, or marketing — and easily add more functionality as your business grows. This ensures you only pay for what you use and have an AI and CRM platform that can grow with your business. Salesforce Starter helps you hit the ground running for free, providing an all-in-one suite of sales, service, and marketing tools designed specifically for small business needs. The setup process is simple so you can focus on building customer relationships immediately, with the peace of mind that the full power of the Salesforce ecosystem is ready whenever you are.

pages.main_text: Public Transportation Alternate Rides and Parking Other Building/Area Info What accessible transportation will get you to and from the office, particularly from the airport? In the airport, take the Plane Train (automated people mover) all the way to baggage claim/ ground transportation. Follow the signs to the Marta train , which is adjacent to baggage claim on both north and south terminals via an automatic sliding glass door. All the ticket gates are wheelchair accessible at the airport. Take the Marta elevator (right in front as you pass through ticket gates) to the platform on level 2. Take the Marta train (Doraville Gold Line) to the Lenox stop (~40 min). There are well-marked accessible loading areas on the outside of the train and a designated wheelchair "parking cubby." The train and platform are level and accessible at every station so anyone using a wheelchair can board easily. Once at the Lenox stop, proceed toward the Salesforce Tower side (the Salesforce Tower side is in the direction of travel of the train). Take the Marta elevator to the concourse and continue across the sky bridge. Take the sky bridge elevator on the left down to the lobby. There are two doors on the sky bridge (the first is not a push-to-open door, but the second one is push to open). From the lobby, go to the elevator bank for elevators 22–34, which is located diagonally from you as you exit the sky bridge. What’s the distance/route to the nearest bus stop/train station (if any)? The Marta Gold Line is connected via the sky bridge to the office building. The sky bridge is roughly 200 yards long. If you cannot reach the office by train, what other accessible modes of transportation are available? The Checker Cab, (404) 351-1111 , offers accessible taxis, but requires arrangements be made at least 48 hrs. in advance. Note: There is no Uber WAV/Lyft Assisted in Atlanta. Does the building have accessible parking? If so, where is it located? Van-accessible spots are located on level 10 of the parking deck, which is connected to the building. A push-to-open door is located on this level. From there, take the elevator down to the lobby. The Marta parking deck is also connected, and accessible parking spots are available next to the elevator bank. Where is the accessible entry/exit located? From the building parking deck on Oak Valley, take the elevator down to the lobby and go directly straight across the lobby to the elevator bank for floors 22–34. From Marta parking deck on Wright Avenue, take the elevator up to the train level 4, then go diagonal across the lobby to the elevator bank for floors 22–34. From the Marta train, go toward the Salesforce Tower side (the Salesforce Tower side is in the direction of travel of the train), take the Marta elevator to Concourse and make your way across the sky bridge. Then take the sky bridge elevator on the left down to the lobby. There are two doors on the sky bridge (the first is not a push-to-open but the second one ispush to open). From the lobby, go to the elevator bank for elevators for floors 22–34, which is located diagonally from you as you exit the sky bridge. From the main entrance of the building on E Paces Ferry, there are push-to-open doors. The side entrance door next to the outdoor patio are two heavy glass doors without push-to-open buttons. - From the sidewalk, use the building’s front entrance on E Paces. There is a ramp/curb cut. - From the car drop-off at the main building entrance, there is a curb cut section in front of the little pillars. Does the office have push-to-open/push buttons to assist in opening doors? This building features multiple push-to-open/push-to-assist doors located in the following areas: - Main building front entrance - Parking deck level 10 - 30th floor  — kitchen entrance door - 33th floor  — reception and kitchen entrance doors - 34th floor  — accessible bathroom door Building Facilities Building Features Is there an elevator in the building to reach the office floors? The elevator bank on the right side of the lobby provides service to the floors 22–34. The 34th floor is only accessible via that floor’s internal elevator. Enter the 33rd floor on the kitchen side, and the elevator to the 34th floor is on the right. Where are the accessible restrooms? Please note that the restroom stalls on each floor are not five-feet-wide wheelchair stalls. They have “accessible” stalls with parallel grab bars but the stalls are narrow. For the private wheelchair bathrooms, please see below: - 30th floor. Use the kitchen entrance. Turn left, and one private wheelchair/gender-neutral restroom is down the hall on the left. - 31st floor. Use the kitchen entrance. Turn left, and two private wheelchair stalls (men/women-identified stalls) are down the hall on the left. - 33rd floor. A gender-neutral/wheelchair-accessible bathroom is located in the elevator bank bathroom outside the office area on the left. - 34th floor. Make a sharp left turn off the 34th floor elevator, and the first door on your left is a push-to-open door to a gender-neutral/wheelchair-accessible bathroom. Where are the gender-neutral restrooms? Gender-neutral bathrooms can be located on the 30th, 33rd, and 34th floors. - 30th floor. Use the kitchen entrance. Turn left, and one private gender-neutral/wheelchair-accessible restroom is down the hall on the left. - 33rd floor. A gender-neutral/wheelchair-accessible bathroom is located in the elevator bank bathroom outside the office area on the left. - 34th floor. Make a sharp left turn off the 34th floor elevator, and the first door on your left is a push-to-open door to a gender-neutral/wheelchair-accessible bathroom. Does the building have a parent’s room or a sanitary, private place to pump milk? One parent’s room is located on the 30th floor. To find the parent's room, use the kitchen entrance. Turn left and it is down the hall on the left. Where is the mindfulness zone located? The parent’s room is also the mindfulness room located on the 30th floor. To find the parent's room, use the kitchen entrance. Turn left and it is down the hall on the left. Where are the barista bars located in the building? The barista bar is located on floor 34. What floors are the snacks on? Snacks are found in the following areas: - Near the kitchen side entrances on the 30th, 31st, and 33rd floors. - In the kitchen on 34th floor, located in the back corner of the floor. What is the distance to nearby restaurants? Restaurants are located in and surrounding the building: - Canteen on Paces (grill/salad bar) is in the building lobby - Wild Leaf (salad and grain bowls) is in the building lobby - Lenox Mall food court (0.4 mi) ~10-minute walk - Publix grocery/Subway (0.3 mi) up a steep hill ~10-minute walk Click here to find restaurants near Salesforce Atlanta. Are service dogs allowed in the building? Service dogs are permitted in the building. Employees must submit a Service Animal Badge Request to Employee Success before bringing the service animal into the building. Vendors and customers do not need to go through the formal process. Are emotional support animals allowed in the building? Emotional support animals are not considered service animals by the local government and therefore are not allowed into the building. How can I request additional support and/or an accommodation related to a disability or medical condition? Customers and guests can work with their host to request disability-related accommodations prior to their visit. Employees can submit a workplace accommodations ticket prior to their visit to put accommodations in place. Requests should be submitted at least five (5) days in advance to ensure our teams have ample time to put accommodations in place. We will do our best to accommodate last-minute requests but cannot guarantee a quick turnaround.

Contact center platforms that support omnichannel communication allow customers to move seamlessly between phone, chat, email, and social channels while giving customer service reps a single view of all interactions. The key features of contact center software include call routing , CRM integration, omnichannel support, workforce management, analytics, and AI-powered tools for efficiency. Contact center software uses AI to automate routine tasks, provide customer service reps with real-time recommendations, analyze sentiment, and deliver personalized customer experiences across digital channels.

Contact us What is business intelligence? Business intelligence, or BI, combines business analytics, data mining, data visualization , data tools and infrastructure, and best practices to help organizations make more data-driven decisions. Modern BI solutions prioritize flexible self-service analysis, governed data on trusted platforms, empowered business users, and speed to insight. In practice, modern business intelligence software enables a comprehensive view of your organization’s data and use that data to drive change, eliminate inefficiencies, and quickly adapt to market or supply changes. What is the difference between traditional and modern BI tools? Historically, business intelligence tools were based on a traditional BI model. This top-down approach to business intelligence was driven by the IT organization and most, if not all, analytics questions were answered via static reports. So, if you had a follow-up question about a report you received, your request would go to the bottom of the reporting queue—essentially restarting the entire process. The traditional BI model led to slow, frustrating reporting cycles, and people weren’t able to leverage current data to make timely decisions. Despite these challenges, traditional business intelligence is still a common approach for regular reporting and answering static queries. In contrast, modern business intelligence is interactive and approachable. While IT departments still play an important role in managing access to data, multiple levels of users can customize dashboards and create reports on little notice. With the proper business intelligence software, users across the business are empowered to visualize data and use that analysis to answer their own questions. What is the value of business intelligence tools and software? BI is more than just software—it’s a way to gain a holistic, real-time view of all your relevant business data. Implementing BI tools offers a myriad of benefits, from better analysis to an increase in competitive advantage. Some of the top business intelligence benefits include: data clarity, increased efficiency, better customer experiences, and improved employee satisfaction. Commerce Cloud is the platform name for a range of products that help digital and IT leaders achieve success across every aspect of ecommerce. We have bundled our commerce products into Editions, which makes it simpler for customers to buy the most complete commerce solution, no matter where you are on your commerce journey. We take a percentage of Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) based on commerce functionality needed. We also have add-on products that are available for purchase outside of our Editions. For more information, please review the detailed product breakdown on this page, or request a call with a sales representative today. What is Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) and how is it calculated? GMV is Gross Merchandise Value which is the total dollar value for merchandise sold. It is the total revenue through your website, minus tax and shipping. For Commerce Cloud Growth and Commerce Cloud Advanced Editions, we charge GMV for the revenue going through your commerce storefront only. How are orders taken outside of Commerce Cloud priced? For orders processed through channels outside of your Commerce Cloud storefront but are leveraging Salesforce Order Management capabilities, there is a separate charge beyond the complementary limits provided with each Edition. For example, Commerce Cloud Advanced pricing is inclusive of all orders taken on your B2B or D2C Commerce storefront. For orders taken on other channels or integrated from any other third-party system, you will need to purchase Salesforce Order Management standalone. Can I upgrade at any time? Can I add more products later on? Yes, of course. You are able to upgrade at any time as well as purchase additional products later on in your contract. We recommend engaging your account representative whenever you have questions around upgrades, add-ons, or contract information. What if I am an existing Commerce Cloud customer? For existing customers, your Account Executive will be able to best assist you with your renewal. In general, existing B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce only customers will be able to leverage Commerce Cloud Growth or Commerce Cloud Advanced. Existing customers with Order Management will need to renew on Commerce Cloud Advanced. Reach out to your Account Executive to understand the best option for your organization.
